subject: Regional Dev Day — budget sign-off, PO ceiling, and invoice routing
messages:
Date: 2026-11-29T09:15:00-08:00
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Subject: Regional Dev Day — budget ask + vendor estimates

Hi team,

We confirmed the venue and tentative headcount (approx 220 devs) for the SF satellite "Regional Dev Day" on Jan 22. BrightSide sent an event estimate (attached) and ACME provided a sample catering menu + pricing. High level numbers: venue + A/V deposit $6,250, catering estimate $9,800, on-site staff/stipend and swag $2,100 — total est $18,150.

Ask: confirmed finance approach for this: 1) can we route as a single PO to BrightSide that covers venue + AV and passes through catering as a subcontract? 2) what PO ceiling/value triggers a multi-GL split? Our preferred cost center is 4202-DEV-MKT but we may need to split sponsorship/stipend into 4206-ENG-OPS.

I attached BrightSide_estimate_111426.pdf and ACME_menu_estimate_11-26.xlsx. BrightSide also needs our W9 and a signed SOW (they can accept e-sign).

TL;DR: please confirm who owns the PO creation, GL code(s), and whether we need a card-exception vs PO for the $6.25k deposit. We need approval to commit the deposit by Dec 9 to hold the space.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-30T10:02:00-08:00
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Subject: RE: Regional Dev Day — budget ask + vendor estimates

Vivek — thanks for the background and attachments. Quick notes from Finance (AP):

- Any vendor >$5,000 requires a PO in our system. 
- A single PO to BrightSide is fine if BrightSide will invoice for both venue and the catering subcontract (consolidated invoice). If ACME insists on direct billing, we need either two POs or ACME added as a subcontractor on the BrightSide PO (legal review).
- GL split: we prefer 70% (4202-DEV-MKT) / 30% (4206-ENG-OPS) for visible cost allocation on the event. Please confirm final split.
- Card exception: we can use a P-card for deposits up to $3k. For $6.25k deposit we need a PO and a formal approval prior to issuing the deposit.
- For vendor onboarding we need BrightSide's W9 and COI; please ask Sarah for those and the SOW link.

Next steps: if you confirm split and vendor invoicing preference, I will create the PO record and route it for finance approval. If legal is needed for subcontractor add, loop in Laura.

- Priyom
Priyom Das
Finance Business Partner, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Date: 2026-12-01T14:27:00-08:00
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Subject: RE: Regional Dev Day — budget ask + vendor estimates

Thanks Priyom. Vivek — proposing final allocation below based on expected attendee mix and partner sponsorship offsets:

- Venue + AV (BrightSide): $6,250 — GL 4202-DEV-MKT (100%)
- Catering (ACME): $9,800 — GL 4202-DEV-MKT (60%) / 4206-ENG-OPS (40%)
- On-site staff + stipends + swag: $2,100 — GL 4206-ENG-OPS (100%)

This nets the 70/30 blended split overall. We should keep the PO to BrightSide for admin simplicity; BrightSide will issue a consolidated invoice showing ACME as a subcontractor line. I spoke briefly with Sarah — they can invoice in one invoice if we add ACME to their subcontractor list. They asked for an SOW signed by us and a 50% deposit to hold the date.

Please create the PO with the following draft memo: "Regional Dev Day — Jan 22/2027 — venue, AV, subcontracted catering" and the GL splits above. Priyom — let me know if AP needs any extra approval flow for the deposit amount (we may need a director-level sign-off).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
